items.title: Stellantis CEO reconfirms 2026 guidance, says turnaround plan continues as automaker's shares hit new low
items.summary: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa on Wednesday reconfirmed the company's 2026 guidance and its plans to be cash flow positive by 2027.
items.title_zh: Stellantis 首席执行官重申 2026 年指引，称转型计划继续推进，公司股价创出新低
items.summary_zh: Stellantis 首席执行官 Antonio Filosa 周三重申公司 2026 年指引，以及到 2027 年实现正现金流的计划。

items.title: US FTC reported to be stepping up its investigations into AI giants including Anthropic and OpenAI; officials say this will not hinder AI leadership
items.summary: The US Federal Trade Commission is intensifying a broad investigation into frontier AI labs to uncover potential consumer risks from their technology, and plans to issue formal information demands akin to subpoenas to these tech giants
items.title_zh: 美FTC被曝加大对Anthropic、OpenAI等AI巨头调查力度，官员称不会妨碍AI主导地位
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）正在加大对前沿AI实验室的全面调查力度，以揭示其技术可能给消费者带来的潜在风险，并计划向这些科技巨头下达类似于传票的正式调取信息的要求

items.title: Goldman strategists warn: earnings are temporarily steadying equities, but a faster Treasury selloff could pressure US stocks
items.summary: Global bond yields are hovering near multi-decade highs, testing the resilience of US equities
items.title_zh: 高盛策略师警示：盈利支撑暂稳股市，美债抛售若提速，美股或将承压
items.summary_zh: 全球债券收益率徘徊在数十年高位附近，美股韧性正面临考验

items.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
items.summary: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.
items.title_zh: 美国财政部设立学生贷款支持中心，新数据显示 930 万借款人违约
items.summary_zh: 特朗普政府周三宣布，为已经逾期的学生贷款借款人设立“违约贷款支持中心”

items.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
items.summary: The probe adds to the mounting scrutiny that OpenAI and Anthropic have been facing over their safety practices following the Hugging Face hack.
items.title_zh: FTC 正就产品风险调查 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 公司
items.summary_zh: 在 Hugging Face 遭黑客攻击后，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 在安全实践方面面临日益增多的审视，此次调查进一步加剧了这种压力。
